director_review_boundaries: Stage B entry after Stage A result
Stage C entry after prerequisite evidence
non_goals: Restoring same color alone is not success.
Do not reinterpret the failed V1 Batch1/Batch32 decision rule.
Do not use provenance-only requirements as scientific gates.

stages.budget: Joint <=7200 GPU seconds; <=3600 per arm; no launch until distinct protocol authorization.
stages.evaluation: One prospectively frozen decoding/scoring condition for both arms; paired atomic, composition and retention deltas; FINAL_AUDIT sealed.
stages.expected_capability_gain: Preserve same color while measuring weak-atomic improvement under identical conditions.
stages.intervention: Matched control/treatment; only protection/replay family allocation differs through explicit train-only same-color coverage.
stages.name: ANTI_FORGETTING_MECHANISM
stages.retention_protection: same color, recolor and selector prerequisites are measured as protected strong capabilities; TARGET_DEV and RETENTION_SENTINEL remain evaluation-only.

stages.budget: Allocated prospectively from remaining global cap after Stage A actual charge.
stages.evaluation: Same frozen development/retention protocol; use paired deltas; no FINAL_AUDIT.
stages.expected_capability_gain: Move independently measured weak primitives toward STRONG >=0.75 without unacceptable forgetting.
stages.intervention: Progressively target connected components, inside/contains, difference, width and orientation while retaining explicit preservation coverage for strong primitives.
stages.name: ATOMIC_PREREQUISITE_REPAIR
stages.retention_protection: Preservation coverage is explicit and reported for every strong baseline capability.
stages.starting_checkpoint: Selected valid Stage-A checkpoint only after review

stages.budget: Allocated prospectively; cumulative total never exceeds 28800 seconds.
stages.evaluation: Test atomic-to-composition transfer on frozen composition DEV; no FINAL_AUDIT.
stages.expected_capability_gain: Composition improves beyond what is explained by atomic changes alone.
stages.intervention: Increase relation-selector-action, conditional action, mask-set-construction and related chains only when prerequisite profile justifies it.
stages.name: COMPOSITION_TRAINING
stages.retention_protection: Keep explicit strong-capability replay and retention evaluation.
stages.starting_checkpoint: Best scientifically valid Stage-B checkpoint after review

stages.budget: Inference only unless a separately reviewed protocol changes it.
stages.evaluation: Pre-frozen transfer protocol; FINAL_AUDIT remains sealed until final model and protocol selection.
stages.expected_capability_gain: Demonstrate or falsify transfer beyond the synthetic repair surfaces.
stages.intervention: No training intervention; evaluate on an appropriately separated ARC development set.
stages.name: GENUINE_ARC_TRANSFER
stages.retention_protection: ARC development tasks remain separated from all train/DEV/retention/final roles.
stages.starting_checkpoint: Selected model only after prior stage selection is closed

success_definition: Measured atomic improvement followed by composition improvement without unacceptable forgetting, then transfer evidence on separated ARC development tasks.
